title: Handles aren't installed, bottom is thin and fragile
text:
Handles aren't installed, bottom is thin and fragile. I could have made these out cardboard boxes and they would have been just as sturdy. The bottom is a flimsy, almost see through piece of plastic. Anything beyond underwear is too heavy.

Then there's the issue if the so called rope "handles". They aren't even installed. You're expected to tie them off and insert them yourself. Not a huge big deal, but seriously? The rope pieces are very thick, so tying the knots leaves huge, chunky knots that take up storage space. At best, we'll use these for shoes by the back door and not as closet organization.
